description.text: Major courses include Accounting Fraud Check, Management Accounting Research, Management Control Research, etc.

duration.text: The Financial Management at Dongbei University of Finance and Economics is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 165 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 5138 USD/per year ￥ 37000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number & expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Postgraduate school transcript 4.Master's degree diploma Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. 5.Letters of recommendation From professor or associate professor or equivalents 6.English proficiency test certificate IELTS 6.5 or TOEFL 100, only for applicant whose native language is not English.
